## Input convention

Direct tools keep URL-template values under `path`, URL query values under `query`, and JSON payloads under `body`. This avoids collisions between body and URL fields. Array query parameters follow their OpenAPI `style` and `explode` rules.

Three upload operations are missing request schemas in the source document. Those tools additionally expose a `multipart` compatibility object. File fields use `{filename, media_type, data_base64}`; this behavior is clearly marked in each tool description and remains bounded by the configured request size limit.

## Result convention

Results contain `status_code`, `content_type`, selected safe response headers, `body`, and an `encoding` discriminator. JSON and text are returned directly; binary bodies use base64. Non-success upstream responses become MCP tool errors with bounded, credential-redacted excerpts.
